quarterly_data.signal: Marine service order (release): Wärtsilä signed a five-year service agreement with Finnish ferry operator Viking Line for the passenger ferry Viking XPRS (Helsinki-Tallinn route), making it the third Viking Line vessel under Wärtsilä lifecycle support after Viking Grace and Viking Glory; scope includes maintenance planning, scheduled spare parts, tailored maintenance support and a dedicated Contract Manager; booked in Q2 2026.
